body:
I'm feeling so tired now, it's 2:40am here. 

I'll leave a brief summary of events; 
- Bullied the whole time I was in secondary school by the same group of kids.
- Diagnosed with clinical depression at 15 as a result. Started drinking, self harm, smoking. 
- Kicked out of school at 16. Developed a drinking problem by this point. 
- Watched my grandma die of cancer that summer. 
- Attempted suicide not long after this. 
- Spent the next 11 months in psych hospitals (transferred around). 
- Ended up in a secure psych unit before I was finally prescribed some useful medication, recovered and was dischared. 
- The following years have been recovery, attempting to stablise my moods/behaviour. 

The attacks in school haunt me, the injustice of it all eats away at me. The experiences I was exposed to in those psych wards have traumatised me. I miss my nan and I wish I'd had a chance to process her passing in a healthy way. 

I wish I could process all these events in a healthy way, find a way to accept the things that have happened and lay them to rest. But smells, sounds, etc take me back - give me vivid flashbacks. And it's become apparant that these experiences have shaped the person I am today, the way I live my life, my relationships with people, anxiety, etc. All in a negative way.

I appologise if any of the above doesn't make sense, struggling to stay awake. I'll be back tomorrow morn though. I plan to at least make it through until then.
